newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume hits record high on demand.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume hits record high on demand.

text.p: Istanbul gold volume hit a record high of 1,930 kilograms on Monday versus the previous record of 1,875 kilograms on February 27 and 872 kilos on Friday, dealers said.
Prices rose by 250 lira and $1.50 to end at 1,081,000 lira per gram and $389.50 per ounce.
There was 395 kilos of trade in the afternoon and 1,535 kilos in the morning. Of the total trade, 1,068 kilos was in lira terms and the rest in dollars.
Officials said trade rallied on the Istanbul Gold Exchange on Monday when demand from the free market increased as jewellery sales went up with the summer season.
They said there was 185 tonnes of trade on the Exchange since its inauguration, which amounted to $2.4 billion.
